exception.justification: Justified: Private structural conversion inherits the complete public codec boundary; recording each nested field again would duplicate the same public disclosure.

review.body: { let mut fields = array_fields (v) ? ; let Some (Value :: Unsigned (tag)) = fields . next () else { return Err (Error :: Shape) ; } ; let result = match tag { 0 => Self :: FinalizationEpoch , 1 => Self :: FinalizedPosition , 2 => Self :: RepeatedPosition , 3 => Self :: MissingPosition , 4 => Self :: PositionOutsideEpoch , 5 => Self :: EmptyAuthor , 6 => Self :: EmptyFamily , 7 => Self :: EmptyAuthentication , 8 => Self :: EmptyQuantityName , 9 => Self :: DuplicateQuantityName , 10 => Self :: EmptyUnit , 11 => Self :: ProjectionParent , 12 => Self :: ProjectionRole , 13 => Self :: ReferenceComponent , 14 => Self :: LicenseQualifiers , 15 => Self :: SettlementReferences , 16 => Self :: CoLegRemoval , 17 => Self :: TombstonePosition , _ => return Err (Error :: Shape) , } ; finish (fields) ? ; Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Explicit structural mapping preserves the listed public fields and refuses unsupported shape or bounded arithmetic. It never grants admission; the enclosing codec records the complete input and result.
